crossRefs.note: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and…

translations.web: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.
translations.bsb: Their appearance is like that of horses, and they gallop like swift steeds.
translations.kjv: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
translations.asv: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so do they run.
